# Time2Read

> Personalized, interactive reading adventures for children aged 3–15, with AI-generated illustrations, phonetic learning, and text-to-speech narration.

Time2Read creates never-ending, age-appropriate stories tailored to each child's reading level (PreK–10th grade). The first 3 stories are free; Premium starts with a 7-day free trial, then $9.99/month or $79/year. Every story has a 20-minute reading timer. Premium subscribers get unlimited live story generation, a saved story library, voice narration, and parent analytics.
